title: World4Scorer: Outcome-Grounded World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
comment: 28 pages, 14 figures, 13 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Autonomous driving requires choosing a safe and efficient plan as surrounding traffic evolves. Generate-and-select planners propose multiple trajectories and score them for execution, and they have outperformed representative direct-prediction baselines on NAVSIM. Their scorer must compare plans that were never executed. Driving logs record the future of only the executed trajectory, so matching the logged future can leave predictions for the alternatives unconstrained; a simulator, in contrast, can label the outcome of every candidate. We introduce World4Scorer, which builds the scorer as a trajectory-conditioned JEPA-style predictor: it predicts a state for each candidate and reads the candidate's scores from that state. Simulator outcome labels supervise the states of all candidates, and the observed future of the executed trajectory anchors the predictor to real scene evolution. Because one predictor produces every candidate's state, the anchor can constrain shared parameters used to score unexecuted plans, while the future itself is needed only during training. Generated candidates mostly score well, so a scene-matched bank adds low-scoring plans to the outcome supervision; framewise choices can conflict, so inertial re-ranking keeps consecutive selections consistent. World4Scorer achieves state-of-the-art NAVSIM-v2 performance and a strong adapted-system result on closed-loop Bench2Drive. With the LeWM world model and planning budget fixed, outcome-based scoring also improves manipulation planning on the OGBench-Cube benchmark.

AI.tldr: World4Scorer 将自动驾驶的评分器构建为轨迹条件化的 JEPA 风格预测器：为每个候选轨迹预测状态并从中读取分数，利用模拟器结果标签监督所有候选状态，同时以已执行轨迹的真实未来作为锚定约束，实现 SOTA 的 NAVSIM-v2 性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需随交通演化选择安全高效的规划。生成-选择式规划器提出多条轨迹并打分执行，其评分器必须比较从未真正执行的备选方案。然而驾驶日志仅记录已执行轨迹的未来，导致对备选方案的预测缺乏约束；仿真器则可为每个候选标注结果。因此需要一种能在仿真器结果监督下、同时被真实场景演化锚定的评分方法，以约束未被执行的规划。
AI.method: 提出 World4Scorer，将评分器设计为轨迹条件化的 JEPA 风格预测器：为每个候选轨迹预测一个状态，并从该状态读取候选分数。使用仿真器结果标签监督所有候选的状态，用已执行轨迹的观测未来锚定预测器以贴近真实场景演化；由于单一预测器生成所有候选状态，锚定约束可作用于用于评分的共享参数，而真实未来仅在训练时需要。此外，采用场景匹配的候选库加入低分规划以丰富结果监督，并用惯性重排序（inertial re-ranking）保持相邻选择的一致性。
AI.result: World4Scorer 在 NAVSIM-v2 上取得 SOTA 性能，并在闭环 Bench2Drive 上获得强适配系统结果。在固定 LeWM 世界模型与规划预算的情况下，基于结果的评分还提升了 OGBench-Cube 基准上的操作规划表现。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹条件化、以仿真器结果监督并以真实未来锚定的 JEPA 风格评分器，能有效约束未执行候选的预测，在自动驾驶与操作规划任务上均取得优异表现，验证了基于结果的评分范式的通用性与有效性。

title: One from Infinity: Actualizing Futures from Pretrained World Models into Robot Actions
summary: A pretrained video world model admits many plausible futures for a scene, but a robot must realize the exact task-conditioned one. To turn world models into executable robot policies, existing methods fine-tune the heavy world model backbone using large-scale robot data and computational resources. Challenging this status quo, we argue that the expensive part has already been paid in the world model pretraining since the representation space of a video world model lays out the diverse potential futures. In this case, what remains is to select the future that accomplishes the task and to read out the actions that realize it. We formalize this task as actualization, which learns a task-conditioned selection and realization on top of a prior supplied by a frozen world model. This can be solved by a tiny actualizer model. We implement RoboActualizer with as few as 60M parameters on top of a frozen world model encoder. The actualizer is composed of two lightweight DiT experts that jointly predict future latents and actions by flow matching. The model can be trained entirely on a single GPU with 32 GB peak memory. With up to 100x fewer trainable parameters than existing WAMs and VLAs, RoboActualizer reaches great performance on simulation benchmarks including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0 and five tasks on two real-world platforms, with a low latency of 39 ms that allows real-time control.

AI.tldr: 提出"actualization"范式：冻结视频世界模型，仅训练一个60M参数的tiny actualizer（RoboActualizer）即可将世界模型转化为可执行的机器人策略，无需微调重型骨干。
AI.motivation: 现有将世界模型转为机器人策略的方法需用大规模机器人数据和算力微调重型世界模型骨干，成本高昂。作者质疑这一范式，认为预训练已在世界模型的表示空间中付出了"昂贵代价"——该空间已铺陈出场景多样的潜在未来，剩下的只是选出一个能完成任务的未来并读出对应动作。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为"actualization"：在冻结世界模型提供的先验之上，学习一个任务条件下的选择与实现机制。实现为RoboActualizer，仅60M参数，置于冻结的世界模型编码器之上；由两个轻量级DiT专家组成，通过flow matching联合预测未来latents和动作。
AI.result: 可在单张GPU、峰值内存32GB内完成训练。可训练参数比现有WAMs和VLAs少最多100倍。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0等仿真基准及两个真实平台的五个任务上取得优异性能，延迟低至39ms，支持实时控制。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明无需微调重型世界模型，冻结骨干加轻量actualizer即可高效地将视频世界模型转化为高性能、实时的机器人策略，挑战了必须大规模微调骨干的主流共识。

title: ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning
summary: Latent world models rely on representation geometry for planning, yet regularizing the latent marginal alone does not determine the state-to-state relationships used for action selection. We show that this can cause planning-relevant novelty structure to be weakened as representations are transformed into the final latent used by the planner. We introduce Aligned Transport of Latent Structure (ATLAS), a training objective that explicitly preserves relational geometry while calibrating the global latent distribution. ATLAS transfers normalized pairwise structure from an informative encoder representation to the planning latent and uses Wasserstein embedding matching (WEMReg) to calibrate its marginal through one-dimensional Wasserstein-2 transport. Our analysis shows that relational preservation and marginal calibration impose non-redundant constraints, and connects finite-candidate planning stability to relational distortion, latent-scale mismatch, and prediction error. Instantiated in LeWM, ATLAS improves mean goal-reaching success across PushT, TwoRoom, and OGBench-Cube on both lower- and higher-novelty evaluation subsets, with the largest gain on higher-novelty TwoRoom episodes. Representation and rollout diagnostics further show stronger novelty-related structure in the planning latent, improved marginal calibration, and lower multi-step prediction error. Together, these results highlight preservation of planning-relevant latent geometry as an important ingredient for reliable world-model planning. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出ATLAS训练目标，在标定全局潜分布的同时显式保持状态间关系几何，从而提升世界模型规划的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型依赖表示几何进行规划，但仅正则化潜边缘分布无法决定用于动作选择的状态到状态关系，这可能导致规划相关的新颖性结构在表示被变换为规划器最终潜表示时被削弱。
AI.method: 提出Aligned Transport of Latent Structure（ATLAS）：将来自信息量丰富的编码器表示的归一化成对结构迁移至规划潜表示，并用Wasserstein嵌入匹配（WEMReg）通过一维Wasserstein-2传输标定其边缘分布。理论分析表明关系保持与边缘标定提供非冗余约束，并将有限候选项规划稳定性与关系畸变、潜尺度不匹配及预测误差联系起来。该方法在LeWM中实例化。
AI.result: 在PushT、TwoRoom和OGBench-Cube上，ATLAS在低与高新颖性评估子集均提升平均目标达成成功率，其中高新颖性TwoRoom回合增益最大。表示与rollout诊断进一步显示规划潜中新颖相关结构更强、边缘标定改善、多步预测误差降低。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显保持规划相关的潜几何是可靠世界模型规划的重要要素。

title: SkillWeaver: Agentic Exploration over Neural Interaction Skills for Scalable Robot Data Generation
comment: Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL), 2026
summary: Large-scale demonstrations have driven unprecedented progress in robot learning, yet collecting robot data through teleoperation is expensive and difficult to scale to diverse environments and long-horizon tasks. Simulation offers a scalable alternative, but existing data-generation pipelines often rely on open-loop controllers, scripted skill sequences, or task-specific programs. We introduce SkillWeaver, an agentic framework that autonomously generates robot experience by exploring over Neural Interaction Skills (NIS): reusable, parameterized, closed-loop policies that expose learned physical interaction capabilities to a reasoning agent. Given a task and a simulated environment, a VLM agent reasons about what to do next, invokes and parameterizes NIS to interact with the environment, observes their outcomes, and generates verification, reflection, and memory to guide subsequent exploration. We instantiate NIS as reinforcement-learned policies for closed-loop, contact-rich manipulation and organize exploration as verifier-guided tree search, enabling the agent to discover successful long-horizon behaviors without relying on predetermined execution pipelines. SkillWeaver scales autonomously to 39.1K demonstrations across 14.1K scenes, which we distill into visuomotor policies. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation, training on SkillWeaver-generated experience substantially improves generalization to novel objects, spatial configurations, tasks, and environments, and enables zero- and few-shot sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfer. Our results suggest agentic exploration over neural interaction skills as a scalable alternative for robot data generation.

AI.tldr: SkillWeaver：一个自主生成机器人经验的智能体框架，通过"神经交互技能"（NIS）与VLM智能体的闭环探索，规模化生成机器人数据并蒸馏为视觉运动策略，显著提升泛化与仿真到现实迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 大规模示范推动了机器人学习的进展，但遥操作采集数据成本高、难以扩展到多样环境和长时程任务；仿真虽可扩展，但现有数据生成流程多依赖开环控制器、脚本化技能序列或任务专用程序，缺乏灵活自主性。因此需要一种可扩展、自主的机器人数据生成方案。
AI.method: 提出SkillWeaver智能体框架。核心是"神经交互技能"（NIS）——可复用、参数化、闭环的策略，将习得的物理交互能力暴露给推理智能体。给定任务与仿真环境，VLM智能体推理下一步动作，调用并参数化NIS与环境交互，观察结果，并生成验证、反思与记忆以指导后续探索。NIS实例化为强化学习策略以实现闭环、接触丰富的操作；探索组织为验证器引导的树搜索，从而发现长时程成功行为，无需预设执行流程。
AI.result: SkillWeaver自主扩展至39.1K条示范、14.1K个场景，并蒸馏为视觉运动策略。在仿真基准与真实世界操作中，基于SkillWeaver生成经验训练可显著提升对新颖物体、空间布局、任务和环境的泛化能力，并实现零样本与少样本的sim-to-sim及sim-to-real迁移。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于神经交互技能的智能体式探索，是机器人数据生成的一种可扩展替代方案。

title: Bilinear World Models: Learning Representations with Structured Dynamics for Efficient Control
summary: World models jointly learn latent representations and dynamics that predict how high-dimensional observations evolve under actions. In this work, we propose a JEPA-style world model in which, rather than learning arbitrary latent dynamics, we restrict them to follow a bilinear parameterization. This structure enables efficient planning and control while shifting the modeling burden onto the encoder, encouraging richer representations that expose the controllable geometry of the system. In particular, this structured parameterization allows us to structurally enforce action recoverability, thereby preventing representation collapse by construction. Although prescribing a bilinear parametrization may appear restrictive, we show that a broad class of nonlinear dynamical systems admits a transformation under which the dynamics become bilinear. Empirically, we show across standard 2D and 3D control tasks that representations with bilinear-parameterized dynamics can be learned directly from high-dimensional observations, reducing planning time by nearly three orders of magnitude while retaining or even improving control accuracy. We also propose more demanding regimes of longer-horizon planning and real-time control, and demonstrate that our method succeeds in both, moving JEPA-style world models beyond short-horizon offline planning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种 JEPA 风格世界模型：将潜在动力学限制为双线性参数化，以结构化方式强制动作可恢复性、避免表征坍缩，并在 2D/3D 控制任务中显著加速规划，同时保持或提升控制精度，支持长时域规划与实时控制。
AI.motivation: 世界模型通常联合学习潜在表征与动力学，但任意潜在动力学可能不利于高效规划与控制，且易出现表征坍缩。作者希望引入结构化先验，将建模负担转移到编码器，使表征暴露系统可控几何，并证明双线性参数化虽看似受限，却能覆盖广泛非线性动力系统。
AI.method: 采用 JEPA 风格世界模型，不学习任意潜在动力学，而将其限定为双线性参数化；该结构可高效规划与控制，并能从结构上强制动作可恢复性，从而由构造避免表征坍缩。理论上说明一类广泛的非线性动力系统可通过变换变为双线性形式；实验上从高维观测中直接学习具有双线性参数化动力学的表征，并在标准 2D 与 3D 控制任务中评估，同时设置更长时域规划与实时控制等更严格场景。
AI.result: 在标准 2D 和 3D 控制任务中，模型可直接从高维观测学习双线性参数化动力学；规划时间减少近三个数量级，同时保持甚至提升控制精度。在更长时域规划和实时控制设定下，该方法均能成功，推动 JEPA 风格世界模型超越短时域离线规划。
AI.conclusion: 将潜在动力学限制为双线性参数化是一种有效且并不失一般性的结构化归纳偏置：它把建模负担转向编码器，产生更丰富、暴露可控几何的表征，并通过动作可恢复性防止表征坍缩，从而实现高效规划、长时域规划与实时控制。

title: Staircase Policy: Streaming Inference for World-Action Models with Large Action Chunks
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on predicted future observations, but future prediction adds further inference overhead to already expensive iterative action generation. Action chunking can amortize this cost over multiple actions, yet performance degrades over long execution horizons because later actions remain conditioned on stale observations. We introduce STAIRCASE POLICY, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style WAM and partitions a large action chunk into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages. Near-term actions are executed as soon as they become available, while later actions continue to be refined. At each sub-chunk boundary, the future latent is re-predicted from the latest observation and used to update all unexecuted actions, enabling long-horizon execution without repeated full policy inference. The resulting future-prediction error can further serve as a signal for adaptive chunking. S-WAM achieves 97.7% on LIBERO and 87.9% on LIBERO-Plus, and improves performance across multiple policy backbones and real-robot tasks. It reaches 292.7 executed actions per second, $3.62\times$ the throughput of conventional execution at comparable accuracy, while reducing time-to-first-action from 123.6 to 73.3 ms. With additional inference optimizations, throughput further increases to 642.9 actions per second.

AI.tldr: 提出STAIRCASE POLICY（S-WAM）流式推理与训练框架，将流匹配VLA转化为JEPA式世界-动作模型，通过错位去噪将大动作块切分为子块，实现长时程高效执行。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过预测未来观测来条件化动作生成，提升了机器人操作性能，但未来预测给本已昂贵的迭代式动作生成增加了额外推理开销。动作分块可摊销该成本，但长执行时程下后段动作仍依赖过时观测，导致性能退化。
AI.method: 将流匹配VLA改造为JEPA式WAM，并把大动作块在错位（staggered）去噪阶段切分为子块。近期动作一旦可用即执行，后续动作持续精化；在每个子块边界，从最新观测重新预测未来隐变量并更新所有未执行动作，从而无需重复完整策略推理即可实现长时程执行。未来预测误差还可作为自适应分块的信号。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上达97.7%，LIBERO-Plus上达87.9%，并在多种策略主干与真实机器人任务上均取得提升。执行吞吐达292.7动作/秒，约为传统执行方式的3.62倍（精度相当），首动作时间从123.6ms降至73.3ms；结合额外推理优化，吞吐进一步提升至642.9动作/秒。
AI.conclusion: STAIRCASE POLICY通过流式推理与训练、错位去噪与未来隐变量重预测，在保持精度的同时显著提升长时程机器人的执行吞吐并降低延迟，且能泛化至多种主干与真实任务。

title: In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications
comment: 100 pages, 26 figures, 25 tables. Project page: this https URL ; Code and literature: this https URL
summary: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill- and agent-based execution. Comparing these interfaces clarifies their transfer assumptions and the roles of training, correspondence, and memory in making context useful. Across manipulation and navigation, we examine how these mechanisms preserve taught requirements as objects, environments, and execution conditions change. This analysis links method design to evaluation practices that distinguish responsiveness to teaching, physical transfer, and benefits from retained experience. The resulting agenda connects compositional task acquisition and faithful transfer with physical recursive self-improvement, in which experience improves the ability to learn subsequent tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文综述通用机器人如何将上下文中的演示与交互转化为物理行动，围绕“上下文证据—执行”的接口，将机器人上下文学习（ICL）方法分为四类：上下文条件策略、几何演示迁移、基于世界模型的控制、基于技能与智能体的执行。分析聚焦这些接口的迁移假设，以及训练、对应关系与记忆在使上下文有用方面的作用。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人需要推断新任务要求，并把理解转化为合适的物理动作。机器人ICL通过演示和交互引导已有能力，且在部署时保持神经参数固定，因此需要系统梳理不同方法如何把上下文证据连接到执行，并厘清其迁移前提与评估重点。
AI.method: 采用文献综述与分类比较的方法，按连接上下文证据与执行的接口划分四类：1）上下文条件策略；2）几何演示迁移；3）基于世界模型的控制；4）基于技能与智能体的执行。比较这些接口的迁移假设与训练、对应、记忆的作用，并跨操作与导航任务考察对象、环境和执行条件变化时，机制如何保持已教要求。
AI.result: 通过比较四类接口，论文澄清了不同方法在迁移假设上的差异，并将方法设计与评估实践联系起来，区分对教学的响应性、物理迁移以及保留经验带来的收益。综述覆盖操作与导航场景，强调对象、环境与执行条件变化下保持任务要求的问题。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出一个研究议程：将组合式任务获取与可靠迁移相连接，并指向物理递归自我改进，即经验能够提升后续任务的学习能力。核心贡献在于以“上下文—执行接口”为组织框架，统一分析机器人ICL的迁移机制与评估标准。

title: LIBERO-MAX: Do Robot Policies Adapt When the World Changes?
comment: 42 pages, 15 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Robots must often continue a task after a target moves, the viewpoint shifts, or an obstacle appears, even though their earlier observations and committed actions reflect the previous scene. Many simulation robustness benchmarks fix external conditions at reset, leaving this temporal challenge underexamined. We introduce LIBERO-MAX, a benchmark of 8,000 paired cases spanning eight types of changes to geometry, observations, appearance, clutter, and paths. Each pair compares task execution with and without a mid-task event, holding the task, initial state, policy seed, and pre-event action sequence fixed. This controlled comparison distinguishes event-associated regressions from failures already present without the change. Across fourteen current VLA, hybrid, and world-action policies, events reduce success by 11.0-25.7 percentage points. Event profiles reveal shared vulnerabilities to geometry and observation changes, while policy-family rankings interleave. Camera controls show that robustness reflects both competence under the changed conditions and the trajectory from which they are encountered; varying query cadence does not eliminate the gap. Together, the paired protocol and temporal diagnostics establish LIBERO-MAX as a reproducible testbed for diagnosing failures under mid-execution changes and measuring progress toward robot policies that remain effective as the world changes.

AI.tldr: LIBERO-MAX：面向任务执行中途环境变化的机器人策略鲁棒性基准，通过8,000组配对对照实验揭示现有VLA等策略在动态变化下的显著性能下降。
AI.motivation: 机器人在目标任务移动、视角改变或障碍出现后仍需继续执行任务，但其此前的观测与已执行动作反映的是旧场景。现有仿真鲁棒性基准多在重置时固定外部条件，对这种"任务执行中途发生变化"的时间维度挑战研究不足。
AI.method: 提出LIBERO-MAX基准，包含8,000个配对案例，覆盖几何、观测、外观、杂乱度、路径等八类变化。每组配对对比"有/无中途事件"两种执行情况，并固定任务、初始状态、策略随机种子及事件前的动作序列，从而将事件相关的性能退化与未发生事件时就已存在的失败区分开。采用同一受控协议，并引入事件画像与相机控制等时间维度诊断手段。
AI.result: 在14种当前主流的VLA、混合式及world-action策略上测试，中途事件使成功率下降11.0至25.7个百分点。事件画像显示各策略对几何与观测变化存在共同脆弱性，而不同策略家族的排名出现交错。相机控制实验表明鲁棒性既取决于变化条件下的胜任能力，也取决于遭遇变化时所处的轨迹；调整查询频率（query cadence）无法消除该性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 配对协议与时间维度诊断共同确立了LIBERO-MAX作为可复现测试平台的价值，可用于诊断机器人策略在执行中途变化下的失败，并衡量其向"世界变化时仍持续有效"这一目标迈进的进展。

title: FineART: Fine-grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation
comment: 26 pages. Code and model weights will be integrated into Hugging Face LeRobot this https URL
summary: Robots operating in real-world environments must execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets struggle to support this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode while the rare bimanual effort that does label subtasks annotates only a fraction of its hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset of 40,543 episodes, 1,718 hours, and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask, and show that mid-training it this way yields substantial gains. Specifically, success on a spatial disambiguation task increases from 32.0% to 100.0%, and step-by-step human subtask guidance lifts success on an unseen long-horizon task from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, after minimal fine-tuning on a new robot, the policy requires one-tenth the data of baselines without mid-training and generalizes zero-shot to completely unseen tasks on the new hardware. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出密集标注的双臂操作数据集 FineART 及可自预测下一子任务的 VLA 策略 FineART-VLA，显著提升长程双臂任务成功率，并降低新机器人适配数据需求。
AI.motivation: 真实环境中的机器人需执行长时程、多步骤双臂任务，但现有操作数据集难以支撑：单臂数据集虽达数十万条轨迹，通常每回合仅有一条高层指令；少数双臂数据集虽标注子任务，却只覆盖部分时长，缺乏密集子任务监督。
AI.method: 构建 FineART 数据集：40,543 条回合、1,718 小时、533,913 个子任务，覆盖 151 个任务。提出 FineART-VLA 视觉-语言-动作策略，使其在中期训练中预测自身下一子任务，并利用该子任务预测进行长程任务执行。
AI.result: 空间消歧任务成功率从 32.0% 提升至 100.0%；在未见长程任务上，逐步人工子任务引导将成功率从 16.0% 提升至 76.0%。在新机器人上仅需少量微调后，策略所需数据为未中期训练基线的十分之一，并能对新硬件上完全未见任务实现零样本泛化。
AI.conclusion: FineART 与 FineART-VLA 表明，密集子任务标注和自预测下一子任务能有效支持长程双臂操作，提升任务成功率、数据效率与跨机器人/跨任务泛化能力；数据集、模型权重与训练代码均已开源。

title: Reactive Real-Time Flow Policies via Asynchronous Distribution Alignment
summary: Generalist robot policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) have achieved remarkable generalization, but their inference delays can conflict with the demands of real-time control. Asynchronous execution avoids pauses between action chunks by predicting the next sequence of actions while the robot carries out the previous one. In this paper, we study whether asynchronous execution produces the same action distribution as the original VLA. We find that, for non-Markovian demonstrations, asynchronous execution can produce a fundamentally different action distribution, which can limit the policy's reactivity. In our method, we seek to restore this reactivity by aligning the asynchronously produced action distribution with that of the original VLA through two complementary mechanisms. First, Recursive Flow-Field Distillation trains the asynchronous policy using the VLA's action-generation flow. We characterize the learned distribution theoretically and show experimentally that our asynchronous policy can generate nearly the full range of actions the original VLA would produce, while existing asynchronous methods recover only a fraction of that range. Second, Propose-Resolve prepares multiple action sequences asynchronously and uses the latest observation to select among them based on a lightweight approximation of their likelihood under the VLA's action distribution. Our resulting method matches the original VLA's success on LIBERO and retains about 80% of its success on RoboMimic, about 30 percentage points more than existing asynchronous methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究VLA异步执行是否保持原动作分布，发现非马尔可夫演示下异步会显著改变分布并降低反应性；提出递归流场蒸馏与Propose-Resolve两种机制，使异步策略恢复原VLA动作分布，在LIBERO上持平、RoboMimic上保留约80%成功率。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略（如VLA）泛化能力强，但推理延迟与实时控制需求冲突。异步执行可在机器人执行上一动作块时预测下一动作序列，从而避免动作块之间的停顿；然而其是否产生与原VLA相同的动作分布尚不明确，尤其在非马尔可夫演示中可能产生根本不同的动作分布，限制策略反应性。
AI.method: 提出两种互补机制以对齐异步动作分布与原VLA分布：1）递归流场蒸馏（Recursive Flow-Field Distillation）：利用VLA的动作生成流训练异步策略，并从理论上刻画所学分布；2）Propose-Resolve：异步准备多个动作序列，并基于VLA动作分布下的轻量似然近似，用最新观测选择动作序列。
AI.result: 实验表明，异步策略能生成原VLA几乎完整范围的动作，而现有异步方法仅恢复其中一小部分；在LIBERO上成功率与原VLA持平，在RoboMimic上保留约80%的成功率，比现有异步方法高约30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 异步执行并非天然保持原VLA动作分布，非马尔可夫演示下会限制反应性；通过流场蒸馏与基于最新观测的候选序列选择，可有效恢复异步策略的反应性并显著缩小与同步VLA的性能差距。

title: Scouting the Dynamics Gap: Test-Time Policy Adaptation via Action-Outcome Feedback
comment: Accepted to Conference of Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
summary: While pretrained robotic policies exhibit impressive capabilities in controlled environments, unobserved physical properties and dynamics require these policies to rapidly adapt during deployment. Existing test-time adaptation methods typically rely on sparse scalar rewards, failing to exploit the rich geometric and dynamic feedback from the environment during physical interaction. To address this challenge, we propose SCOUT, a dynamics-aware meta-learning framework that enables manipulation policies to rapidly adapt by continuously revising their internal beliefs about environment dynamics. Our approach couples an action-prediction policy with a forward dynamics model via a shared belief latent space. During meta-training, an inner loop updates this shared belief latent by minimizing the dynamics prediction error against the observed action outcome, while the outer loop optimizes the network for action selection. At deployment, this structure allows the agent to infer and adapt to unknown physical dynamics on the fly. By updating its latent belief based on action-outcome mismatches, the policy automatically adapts without risking catastrophic forgetting. We demonstrate that SCOUT significantly accelerates online adaptation across simulated manipulation benchmarks and achieves robust sim-to-real transfer in the real world. AI.tldr: SCOUT：一种动力学感知的元学习框架，通过共享信念隐空间将动作预测策略与前向动力学模型耦合，使机器人操作策略在部署时利用动作-结果失配在线更新隐信念，从而快速适应未知物理动力学，并在仿真操作基准和真实世界sim-to-real迁移中取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略在受控环境中表现良好，但面对未观测的物理属性与动力学时，需要在部署阶段快速适应。现有测试时适应方法多依赖稀疏标量奖励，未能充分利用物理交互中丰富的几何与动力学反馈。
AI.method: 提出SCOUT动力学感知元学习框架：动作预测策略与前向动力学模型通过共享的信念隐空间耦合。元训练时，内循环以观测到的动作结果为监督，最小化动力学预测误差来更新共享信念隐变量；外循环优化网络以提升动作选择。部署时，智能体基于动作-结果失配更新隐信念，实时推断并适应未知物理动力学，且不冒灾难性遗忘风险。
AI.result: 在多个仿真操作基准上显著加速在线适应；在真实世界中实现稳健的sim-to-real迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并在线修正对环境动力学的内部信念，SCOUT为机器人操作策略提供了一种无需稀疏奖励、可快速测试时适应且具现实迁移能力的学习范式。

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
summary: We study reinforcement learning (RL) methods for cooperative multi-agent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. This problem is challenging because VLAs are pretrained on large-scale single-agent data and therefore lack the fine-grained coordination skills required for inter-robot collaboration. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on multi-robot demonstrations partially bridges this gap, but its performance is bounded by the demonstration data and cannot improve from its own experience. We present a three-stage reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) pipeline for multi-agent VLAs. First, initialization-aware data collection sweeps over initial configurations and invokes human demonstrations only when the pretrained VLA repeatedly fails, yielding robustness to initialization shift with reduced human cost. Second, offline credit-filtered tuning assigns credit to individual agents and fine-tunes on per-agent trajectories with positive advantage rather than on entire joint rollouts. Third, we find existing online RL for VLAs are less effective for hard multi-agent tasks, which we attribute to noisy co-exploration and unstable updates. We instead use online latent-space fine tuning, which freeze the VLA and perform RL in its latent noise space. We evaluate our multi-agent VLA with both $\pi_0$ and $\pi_{0.5}$ backbones across 11 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboFactory and real-world manipulation with two Franka robots. Our multi-agent VLA improves the average success rate by $+23.1\%$, $+16.4\%$, and $+44\%$ on RoboTwin, RoboFactory, and real-world tasks, respectively. Code available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 面向多机器人协作的VLA模型，提出三阶段强化微调（RFT）流水线：初始化感知数据采集、离线信用过滤微调、在线潜空间微调；在RoboTwin、RoboFactory和真实Franka双机器人任务上平均成功率分别提升+23.1%、+16.4%、+44%。
AI.motivation: 预训练VLA基于大规模单智能体数据，缺乏机器人间细粒度协调能力；多机器人示范的SFT受限于示范数据，无法从自身经验中继续提升。
AI.method: 三阶段RFT：1）初始化感知数据采集，扫描初始配置，仅在预训练VLA反复失败时调用人类示范，降低人工成本并提升对初始状态偏移的鲁棒性；2）离线信用过滤微调，将信用分配给单个智能体，仅在正优势的每智能体轨迹上微调，而非整段联合轨迹；3）在线潜空间微调，冻结VLA，在其潜噪声空间中进行RL，以缓解多智能体硬任务中协同探索噪声大和更新不稳定的问题。
AI.result: 基于π0与π0.5骨干，在RoboTwin、RoboFactory的11个任务及真实双Franka机器人操作中评估；平均成功率分别提升+23.1%、+16.4%和+44%。
AI.conclusion: 该多智能体VLA强化微调框架有效提升协作操作性能，验证了离线信用分配与潜空间在线RL在多机器人VLA任务中的有效性，并已开源代码。

title: Where Predictive Supervision Goes Shapes What VLA Policies Learn
comment: 38 pages (9 pages main text + appendix), 13 figures, 21 tables
summary: Future prediction is increasingly used to improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies, based on the premise that anticipating scene evolution encourages representations useful for control. However, forecast quality alone does not establish that a policy has learned a better representation for action. This distinction matters under distribution shift, where successful control depends on preserving spatial state and likely scene change beyond familiar configurations. We study what determines whether predictive supervision improves the visual representation used by a VLA policy. Through controlled comparisons with matched target constructions, prediction horizons, and training conditions, we find that different prediction interfaces produce markedly different forecasts and visual representations, including in the spatial, dynamics, and action information that transfers beyond familiar scenes. We trace these differences to how predictive errors shape the policy's visual stream. Consistent with this controlled finding, VLA policies trained with more direct, scene-matched future supervision show stronger robustness under simulated and physical distribution shifts. Together, our results frame future prediction as a representation-learning design problem whose value for control depends on whether its supervision reaches the representations through which the policy acts.

AI.tldr: 论文研究未来预测监督对VLA策略视觉表征的影响，指出预测接口设计决定表征质量与分布偏移鲁棒性；更直接、场景匹配的未来监督更有效。
AI.motivation: 未来预测被广泛用于改进VLA策略，其前提是预测场景演化能学到有利于控制的表征。但预测质量本身并不能证明策略学到了更好的动作表征；在分布偏移下，成功控制依赖保留空间状态与可能的场景变化，因此需厘清预测监督何时真正改善视觉表征。
AI.method: 通过控制变量比较，匹配目标构造、预测时域和训练条件，分析不同预测接口产生的预测结果与视觉表征差异，包括可迁移到陌生场景的空间、动力学和动作信息；并追溯预测误差如何塑造策略的视觉流。
AI.result: 不同预测接口产生显著不同的预测和视觉表征；与场景更匹配、更直接的未来监督训练出的VLA策略，在模拟和物理分布偏移下表现出更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 未来预测应被视为表征学习设计问题；其对控制的价值取决于监督信号是否能到达策略实际动作所依赖的表征。

title: T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics
summary: Memory-dependent robotic manipulation requires policies to use information that is no longer available in the current observation. Retaining history alone is insufficient: memory must preserve information that supports future actions. One challenge is whether a memory-free foundation model can learn to retain and use historical information from action demonstrations alone, without external memory support. We introduce T$^2$Mem, a framework that develops this capability within a pretrained vision-language-action policy, without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. T$^2$Mem uses test-time training to encode observation history into compact fast weights through online self-supervised updates, avoiding repeated processing of the full history. An observation-grounded interface extracts vision-language information for memory formation and supplies retrieved context to the action expert. Action supervision shapes what the memory learns to retain and use, while alternating memory-policy learning gives each component a fixed counterpart during optimization. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, T$^2$Mem improves average success from 17.93% to 56.83% over the memory-free base policy and outperforms the recurrent-memory methods reported in the benchmark, while controlled profiling indicates at least 3x inference speedup over explicit methods. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: T²Mem 让预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型在无外部记忆模块、无记忆专用标注的条件下，通过测试时训练与在线自监督更新，将观测历史编码为紧凑的快权重（fast weights），从而获得记忆依赖的机器人操作能力；在 16 个 RoboMME 任务上平均成功率由 17.93% 提升至 56.83%，并较显式记忆方法至少有 3 倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 记忆依赖的机器人操作要求策略利用当前观测中已不存在的信息。仅保留历史并不充分：记忆必须保留能够支持未来动作的信息。核心问题是：一个无记忆的基础模型能否仅凭动作示范，在没有外部记忆支持的情况下学会保留并使用历史信息。
AI.method: T²Mem 在预训练 VLA 策略内部发展记忆能力，不依赖外部推理模型或记忆专用标注。其做法是用测试时训练（test-time training）通过在线自监督更新把观测历史编码为紧凑的快权重，避免重复处理完整历史；设计观测接地的视觉-语言接口，既为记忆形成提取视觉-语言信息，又向动作专家提供检索到的上下文；由动作监督塑造记忆需要保留和使用的内容；采用记忆与策略的交替学习，使优化过程中每个组件都有固定的对应方。
AI.result: 在 16 个 RoboMME 任务上，T²Mem 将平均成功率从无记忆基策略的 17.93% 提升到 56.83%，超过基准中报告的循环记忆方法；受控性能分析表明，相较显式记忆方法至少获得 3 倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，无记忆的 VLA 基础模型仅依靠动作示范即可学会保留与使用历史信息，并通过快权重式记忆实现高效、无需外部记忆支持的记忆依赖操作。

title: Beyond Token Importance: Preserving Spatial Scaffolds for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Existing VLA pruning strategies primarily select individual visual tokens according to task-level semantic relevance, while overlooking the spatial information required for robotic manipulation. To examine this limitation, we construct a simple Stride baseline that uniformly samples tokens along the flattened one-dimensional visual sequence, representing a purely geometric pruning strategy. Surprisingly, Stride outperforms semantic pruning and random pruning at certain pruning ratios, but collapses when the token budget is only slightly reduced. We characterize this phenomenon through the spatial coverage radius, defined as the largest spatial blind spot induced by the retained token set after pruning. Our analysis reveals a strong correlation between the spatial structure of retained tokens and task success, suggesting that reliable VLA pruning requires preserving not only task-relevant tokens but also the spatial scaffold of the scene. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose GeoScaffold, a training-free visual token pruning method that partitions each image into spatial regions, allocates inter-region token budgets using task-relevance weights, and selects intra-region scaffold tokens via farthest point sampling to reduce the local coverage radius. On pi 0.5 and LIBERO, GeoScaffold retains only 20% of visual tokens while preserving a 93.2% average success rate, and achieves a 1.78 times prefill speedup over the unpruned baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的视觉token剪枝方法GeoScaffold，通过空间区域划分与最远点采样保留场景空间骨架，在仅保留20%视觉token时仍保持93.2%成功率，并实现1.78倍预填充加速。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）剪枝策略主要依据任务级语义相关性选择单个视觉token，忽视了机器人操作所需的空间信息。作者构建了纯几何的Stride基线（沿一维展平序列均匀采样），发现其在某些剪枝比下优于语义剪枝和随机剪枝，但token预算略减便崩溃，表明仅保留任务相关token不足以支撑可靠剪枝。
AI.method: 引入“空间覆盖半径”（剪枝后保留token集所诱导的最大空间盲区）来刻画该现象，发现保留token的空间结构与任务成功率强相关。据此提出GeoScaffold：免训练，将每张图像划分为空间区域，依据任务相关性权重分配区域间token预算，并在区域内通过最远点采样（FPS）选取骨架token以降低局部覆盖半径。
AI.result: 在pi 0.5和LIBERO上，GeoScaffold仅保留20%视觉token即可维持93.2%的平均成功率，相比未剪枝基线实现1.78倍的预填充（prefill）加速。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的VLA剪枝不仅要保留任务相关token，还须保留场景的空间骨架；空间覆盖半径是诊断剪枝有效性的关键指标，GeoScaffold以几何骨架保留实现了高效且高成功率的免训练剪枝。

title: LexiconVLA: Learning Reusable Atomic Action Codebooks for Unseen Tasks
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle to reuse recurring interactions in unseen tasks. Our diagnostic study reveals that reliable task completion does not imply consistent execution of constituent atomic actions across task contexts. We present LexiconVLA, a retrievable atomic-action lexicon for cross-task reuse. Global and detail codebooks capture shared interaction structure and fine-grained execution variation, respectively, preserving both reusable patterns and execution details. Visual-Atomic Action Alignment couples trajectory reconstruction from visual state changes with visual outcome prediction from action codes, grounding the lexicon in motion and its effects. We learn these codebooks with trajectory reconstruction and visual alignment on our AtomAction Dataset of 57,803 segments from 69 tasks. A planner and scene-aware adapter translate new goals into code-conditioned subtasks for a shared policy, without skill-specific experts or deployment-time parameter updates. Across five policy backbones on 26 RLBench tasks, LexiconVLA largely maintains performance on 18 seen tasks while improving success on 8 tasks held out from policy training. With BridgeVLA, unseen-task success rises from 16.67% to 34.17% (+17.50 percentage points), and overall success reaches 71.08%, the highest among methods with reported results. Real-robot experiments demonstrate stepwise execution and failure recovery.

AI.tldr: LexiconVLA 提出可检索的原子动作词典，通过全局/细节码本与视觉-原子动作对齐，实现跨任务复用原子交互，提升未见任务成功率并支持真实机器人执行。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型难以在未见任务中复用重复出现的交互模式；诊断研究表明，任务整体完成可靠，并不代表其组成原子动作在不同任务上下文中能被一致执行。
AI.method: 构建 LexiconVLA：用全局码本捕获共享交互结构，用细节码本捕获细粒度执行变化；提出 Visual-Atomic Action Alignment，将基于视觉状态变化的轨迹重建与基于动作码的视觉结果预测耦合，使词典同时扎根于运动及其效果；在 AtomAction Dataset（69 个任务、57,803 个片段）上以轨迹重建和视觉对齐学习码本；推理时由 planner 与 scene-aware adapter 将新目标转化为码条件子任务，交由共享策略执行，无需技能专用专家或部署时参数更新。
AI.result: 在 RLBench 的 26 个任务、5 种策略骨干上，LexiconVLA 在 18 个已见任务上基本保持性能，并在 8 个未参与策略训练的任务上提升成功率；与 BridgeVLA 结合时，未见任务成功率从 16.67% 升至 34.17%（+17.50 个百分点），总体成功率达 71.08%，为已报告结果方法中最高；真实机器人实验展示了逐步执行与失败恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过可检索原子动作词典与视觉-动作对齐，LexiconVLA 能在不增加技能专家和在线参数更新的情况下实现跨任务原子动作复用，兼顾已见任务性能与未见任务泛化，并具备真实机器人部署潜力。

title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Current embodied models do not respond to their own failures, although what just went wrong could inform a small adjustment on the next attempt, the kind of reflection behind the gains of thinking in language models. We test whether they can repair a known error, which requires producing a correction and judging whether it is right. Stopped at a failure and allowed to retry, they seldom repair it through their own randomness or from a language description of the error, and best-of-N selection cannot pick the successful candidate after a failure. We attribute this to training only on successful demonstrations and to inputs too narrow to show what went wrong, and conclude that reflection must come from a vision-language model (VLM), which takes in far more information, such as the episode history and text, and is more general. Prior VLM-led work has the VLM plan every step and invoke the embodied model as a tool, placing the VLM on the critical path. We propose Spotter, which reverses the roles: the embodied model leads and executes continuously, while the VLM runs in parallel, monitors through a lightweight local screener, intervenes only when an error is detected, reflects on and corrects it, and returns control. We run Spotter with Qwen and with GPT as the VLM, and both improve the embodied models; with GPT, Spotter improves Cosmos Policy and $\pi_{0.5}$ by 5.6 and 7.5 percentage points on RoboCasa, and raises $\pi_{0.5}$ from 47.2% to 57.0% on the Hard setting of RoboTwin 2.0 and from 53% to 83% on a real robot. Because the VLM steps in only when an error is confirmed, a successful episode with Qwen takes only 13 to 16 s longer than with the embodied model alone and about 70% less time than with a VLM-led baseline using the same model. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Spotter 逆转 VLM 与具身模型的角色：具身模型连续主导执行，VLM 并行监控、仅在确认出错时介入反思并纠正，从而提升多类具身模型成功率且显著降低额外耗时。
AI.motivation: 现有具身模型不会对自身失败作出反应，无法利用“刚刚哪里出错”的信息进行下一次尝试的微调；即使被停在失败点并允许重试，它们也很少能通过自身随机性或语言描述修复错误，best-of-N 选择也无法在失败后挑出成功候选。作者将此归因于训练仅依赖成功演示、输入过窄而无法呈现失败原因，认为反思必须来自信息更丰富、更通用的视觉语言模型（VLM）。
AI.method: 提出 Spotter：让具身模型主导并连续执行，VLM 并行运行，通过轻量级局部筛查器监控执行过程；仅当检测到错误时，VLM 才介入，对错误进行反思、生成纠正并判断其是否正确，然后将控制权交回具身模型。方法分别使用 Qwen 和 GPT 作为 VLM 进行验证。
AI.result: 使用 GPT 作为 VLM 时，Spotter 在 RoboCasa 上使 Cosmos Policy 和 π0.5 分别提升 5.6 和 7.5 个百分点；在 RoboTwin 2.0 的 Hard 设置上将 π0.5 从 47.2% 提升到 57.0%，在真实机器人上从 53% 提升到 83%。由于 VLM 只在错误被确认时介入，使用 Qwen 时一个成功回合仅比单独具身模型多 13 至 16 秒，比使用同一模型的 VLM 主导基线少约 70% 的时间。
AI.conclusion: 具身模型的失败修复需要来自 VLM 的反思能力，但不应将 VLM 放在关键路径上；Spotter 通过“具身模型主导执行 + VLM 并行监控与按需介入”的逆转式角色设计，在提升成功率的同时保持了较低的时间开销，说明按需反思是更有效的具身纠错范式。

title: CoRe-VLA: Preserving Cross-View Coordination in VLAs under Camera Shifts
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures
summary: VLAs combine pretrained vision-language representations with action generation to enable language-guided control across diverse tasks, becoming a mainstream paradigm in embodied intelligence. However, multiple studies have reported VLA's substantial declines in task success under camera shifts, revealing a key vulnerability that limits reliable deployment. To address this vulnerability, existing methods collect paired observations of the same scene from different viewpoints to fine-tune the VLA or train visual adaptation modules. Unfortunately, they require additional data collection and VLA training costs. In this paper, we first identify \emph{cross-view coordination breakdown} under external camera shifts: the robot may rely too heavily on wrist-view cues and consequently execute subtasks in the wrong order when losing global view. Motivated by this, we propose CoRe-VLA, a plug-and-play framework requiring neither additional multi-view data collection nor VLA fine-tuning, which can incorporate with exsiting VLAs. It reconstructs a scene point cloud and renders the observation from the VLA's training viewpoint to restore cross-view coordination. In CoRe-VLA, Render-to-Camera (R2C) Restoration reduces rendering-induced visual degradation, while Execution-Trajectory-Conditioned Alignment (ETCA) reduces robot idle time and mitigates motion conflicts during asynchronous execution. Experiments on 5 real-robot tasks, LIBERO-100 and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate CoRe-VLA substantially improves task success across mainstream VLAs under camera shifts. For example, CoRe-VLA raises PI0.5's success rate from 13.3% to 83.3% at a 1.6m camera shift in real-robot environment.

AI.tldr: CoRe-VLA：一种即插即用框架，通过重建场景点云并从VLA训练视角渲染观测来恢复跨视角协调，无需额外多视角数据采集或VLA微调，即可在相机偏移下大幅提升主流VLA的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA将预训练视觉-语言表征与动作生成结合，实现语言引导的多样化任务控制，已成为具身智能主流范式。然而多项研究报道VLA在相机偏移下任务成功率显著下降，暴露了限制可靠部署的关键脆弱性。现有方法需采集同一场景不同视角的配对观测来微调VLA或训练视觉适配模块，代价是额外的数据采集与训练成本。本文进一步识别出外部相机偏移下的"跨视角协调崩溃"现象：机器人可能过度依赖腕部视角线索，在失去全局视角时以错误顺序执行子任务。
AI.method: 提出CoRe-VLA，即插即用框架，无需额外多视角数据采集或VLA微调，可与现有VLA结合。核心做法是重建场景点云，并从VLA的训练视角渲染观测，以恢复跨视角协调。框架包含两个组件：Render-to-Camera（R2C）Restoration，用于减轻渲染引起的视觉退化；Execution-Trajectory-Conditioned Alignment（ETCA），用于减少机器人空闲时间并缓解异步执行过程中的运动冲突。
AI.result: 在5个真实机器人任务、LIBERO-100和LIBERO-Plus上的实验表明，CoRe-VLA在相机偏移下显著提升主流VLA的任务成功率。例如在真实机器人环境中，1.6m相机偏移下，CoRe-VLA将PI0.5的成功率从13.3%提升至83.3%。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-VLA以即插即用的方式有效缓解了VLA在相机偏移下的跨视角协调崩溃问题，在不增加数据采集与训练成本的前提下，大幅提升了任务成功率，为主流VLA的可靠部署提供了实用方案。

title: All You Need Is Low Fidelity: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real of Learned Robotic Fish Control
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures, submitted to ICRA 2027. Liam Maloney and Simon Ramchandani contributed equally
summary: Complex tasks for underwater robots remain limited by the capabilities of their controllers. Learning a better one for a soft, underactuated robotic fish trades simulator cost against fidelity. We show that an intentionally low-fidelity simulator is enough: a stateless, quasi-steady fluid model with no wake and no added-mass history suffices to learn a \emph{general}, closed-loop controller that transfers to hardware without tuning. Our platform is a soft, single-motor, tendon-driven fish whose policy observes only what the hardware can measure. A staged pipeline grounds the simulator in two independent identifications, fixing the tail dynamics and a stateless fluid model; the policy then acts through a band-limited rhythmic trajectory generator rather than commanding the tail directly. Deployed unchanged in an outdoor pool, a single policy performs closed-loop target reaching, disturbance rejection, and out-of-distribution target acquisition and tracking. The transfer rests on the constraint rather than the fidelity: the generator cannot leave the band over which the fluid was identified. This raises the question of how much of the physics can reside in the controller rather than in the simulator.

AI.tldr: 一种故意低保真的无状态准稳态流体仿真器，配合带限节律轨迹生成器，即可学习出可零调整迁移到软体欠驱动机器鱼硬件的通用闭环控制器，完成目标到达、扰动抑制与分布外跟踪。
AI.motivation: 复杂水下任务受限于机器人控制器能力；为软体、欠驱动机器鱼学习更优控制器时，需要在仿真成本与保真度之间权衡，作者希望验证低保真仿真是否足以支撑可迁移的闭环控制。
AI.method: 采用无尾流、无附加质量历史的无状态准稳态流体模型作为低保真仿真器；平台为软体、单电机、肌腱驱动机器鱼，策略仅使用硬件可测状态。通过分阶段流水线，以两个独立辨识分别固定尾部动力学与无状态流体模型；策略不直接控制尾部，而是通过带限节律轨迹生成器输出动作。
AI.result: 策略无需调整即可在户外泳池部署，单一策略实现闭环目标到达、扰动抑制，以及分布外目标获取与跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 迁移能力主要来自约束而非仿真保真度：轨迹生成器被限制在流体模型完成辨识的频带内，从而保证仿真到现实的可用性；这引出“多少物理可驻留于控制器而非仿真器”的问题。

title: EgoHumanoid-V2: Human-to-Humanoid Transfer of Coordinated Whole-Body Skills for Loco-Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations capture diverse scenes and rich whole-body skills without requiring robot teleoperation. Prior work on egocentric transfer has emphasized scene generalization in loco-manipulation under decoupled control, leaving direct transfer of coordinated whole-body skills less explored. We present EgoHumanoid-V2, the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation. At its core, coarse-to-fine action alignment combines kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement. It improves end-effector pose accuracy while preserving whole-body coordination. We also use robot-arm rendering and training-time image augmentation to reduce the visual embodiment gap and improve viewpoint robustness. On four real-world tasks, vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on aligned human data show zero-shot skill transfer without target-task robot demonstrations. Task scores are comparable to those of policies trained on teleoperation data at a lower collection cost. These results support human data as direct skill supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出 EgoHumanoid-V2，一种面向协调全身移动操作的第一人称人类到人形机器人技能迁移框架，通过粗到细动作对齐与视觉域缩小，实现无需目标任务机器人演示的零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人类演示能覆盖多样场景和丰富全身技能，且无需机器人遥操作；但已有第一人称迁移工作多关注解耦控制下的移动操作场景泛化，对协调全身技能的直接迁移研究不足。
AI.method: 核心是粗到细动作对齐：结合运动学参考修正与动力学感知细化，以提高末端执行器位姿精度并保持全身协调；同时采用机器人手臂渲染和训练时图像增强，缩小视觉具身差异并提升视角鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界任务中，使用对齐后人类数据训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，在无目标任务机器人演示条件下实现零样本技能迁移；任务得分与遥操作数据训练的策略相当，且数据采集成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明人类数据可作为直接技能监督，为协调全身移动操作的人到人形机器人技能迁移提供了可行路径。

title: V2X-WAM: A Cooperative World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vehicle-infrastructure cooperation can complement onboard sensing with broader and more informative observations of the traffic environment, providing valuable support for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing cooperative driving methods mainly exploit roadside information to enhance the representation of the current scene, while the future consequences of prospective driving actions are rarely modeled explicitly. This limits the ability of the planner to anticipate how its decisions may interact with the evolving traffic environment. To address this issue, we propose V2X-WAM, a cooperative world action model that tightly couples cooperative scene understanding, action generation, and future-world reasoning. V2X-WAM constructs a reliability-aware spatiotemporal representation from vehicle- and infrastructure-side observations, while compressing infrastructure information into a compact quantized message for efficient communication. Based on the resulting cooperative representation, a multimodal planner generates prospective trajectories, which explicitly condition future occupancy and dynamic-flow prediction. The predicted world consequences are then fed back to refine the planned trajectory, forming a closed interaction between action and future-world evolution. Experiments on a large-scale real-world cooperative driving dataset demonstrate that V2X-WAM consistently improves planning accuracy and safety over representative end-to-end cooperative driving methods, while achieving stronger future-world prediction and substantially lower communication overhead. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed design.

AI.tldr: V2X-WAM：一种车路协同世界动作模型，将协同场景理解、动作生成与未来世界推理紧耦合，提升端到端协同驾驶的规划精度与安全性，并显著降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: 现有协同驾驶方法多利用路侧信息增强当前场景表征，却很少显式建模前瞻驾驶动作的未来后果，导致规划器难以预判决策与动态交通环境的交互。
AI.method: 从车端与路侧观测构建可靠性感知的时空表征，并将路侧信息压缩为紧凑量化消息以实现高效通信；基于该协同表征，多模态规划器生成前瞻轨迹，显式条件化未来占据与动态流预测；随后将预测的世界后果反馈以精炼轨迹，形成动作与未来世界演化的闭环交互。
AI.result: 在大型真实车路协同驾驶数据集上，规划精度与安全性持续优于代表性端到端协同驾驶方法，未来世界预测更强，通信开销显著更低；消融实验验证了各设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: V2X-WAM通过动作生成与未来世界推理的闭环耦合，验证了世界动作模型在协同自动驾驶中的有效性。

title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations in Vision-Language-Action Models via Predicting Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project website: this https URL
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle under visual distribution shifts, often relying on spurious correlations tied to domain-specific factors rather than task-relevant structure. We propose Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead (DILL), a representation-learning framework that mitigates shortcut learning in VLA policies. Our key idea is to supervise policies with domain-invariant future latents learned from domain-transformed trajectory data. A Task-Domain Encoder is trained with contrastive objectives and Gaussian disentanglement regularization to separate task-relevant structure from domain-specific visual variation. The learned encoder then provides future latents for VLA policy learning through lookahead prediction and domain disentanglement, encouraging the policy to focus on task-relevant structure rather than incidental visual factors. Counterfactual task-view evaluations show that DILL reduces shortcut reliance, while LIBERO-Plus evaluations demonstrate improved visual robustness, with 69.1% average success, 11.4 percentage points above the strongest baseline. Real-world manipulation experiments further support DILL's applicability beyond controlled simulation. Complementary latent-space diagnostics show that these behavioral gains are accompanied by representations that better preserve task-consistent structure while suppressing domain-specific variation. Our project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 DILL（域不变潜在前瞻）表示学习框架，通过从域变换轨迹数据中学习域不变的未来潜在表示来监督 VLA 策略，从而缓解视觉分布偏移下的捷径学习。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在视觉分布偏移下表现脆弱，往往依赖与特定域因素相关的伪相关（spurious correlations），而非任务相关的结构信息，即存在捷径学习问题。
AI.method: DILL 的核心思想是用从域变换轨迹数据中学习到的域不变未来潜在表示来监督策略。具体地，训练一个任务-域编码器（Task-Domain Encoder），采用对比学习目标与高斯解耦正则化（Gaussian disentanglement regularization），将任务相关结构从域特定的视觉变化中分离出来；随后该编码器通过前瞻预测（lookahead prediction）与域解耦，为 VLA 策略学习提供未来潜在表示，促使策略关注任务相关结构而非偶然的视觉因素。
AI.result: 反事实任务-视角（counterfactual task-view）评估表明 DILL 降低了对捷径的依赖；LIBERO-Plus 评估显示视觉鲁棒性提升，平均成功率达 69.1%，比最强基线高出 11.4 个百分点；真实世界操作实验进一步验证了其在受控仿真之外的可适用性；潜在空间诊断表明行为增益伴随表征能更好地保留任务一致结构并抑制域特定变化。
AI.conclusion: DILL 通过域不变的未来潜在表示监督，有效缓解 VLA 策略的捷径学习，在仿真与真实场景中均提升了视觉鲁棒性，并通过潜在空间诊断验证其表征质量改善，说明其具有较好的通用性与实际应用潜力。

title: Remember What You Did: Action-History Memory with Dual-Expert Denoising for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have driven rapid progress in robotic manipulation, demonstrating strong fine-grained control and promising performance on long-horizon tasks. However, many existing VLAs lack explicit access to interaction history, making them vulnerable to perceptual aliasing: similar current observations and robot states at different task stages may induce action ambiguity and lower success rate. Existing methods incorporate temporal or progress cues through feature conditioning, action-prior modification, or sampling guidance. However, methods that jointly fine-tune memory modules and the base VLA incur additional policy-training costs, motivating the separation of trainable history-conditioned steering from frozen base-policy refinement. We propose ActMem-VLA, a dual-expert handover architecture that augments a frozen, fine-tuned VLA with a memory plugin comprising a Mamba-based memory module and a lightweight PreAction Expert (PAE). Specifically, Mamba encodes executed-action history into memory that conditions PAE alongside current context. With these inputs, PAE steers task progression during early, high-noise denoising, then passes the partially denoised action to the frozen Action Expert (AE) to refine action details during the remaining low-noise steps. The fine-tuned base VLA remains frozen throughout training, while only the Mamba module and PAE are jointly optimized. On LIBERO-Mem, ActMem-VLA achieves 80.8\% average success across all ten tasks, compared with 65.2\% for $\pi_{0.5}$ and 49.5\% for MemoryVLA, while introducing only 3.45\% additional parameters. Across four real-world tasks, it improves the average success rate over $\pi_{0.5}$ by 28.8\%.

AI.tldr: ActMem-VLA 提出一种双专家交接架构，将可训练的记忆插件（Mamba 记忆模块 + 轻量 PreAction Expert）与冻结的微调 VLA 相结合，通过分离"可训练的历史条件引导"与"冻结的基础策略精炼"来缓解感知混叠问题，在仅增加 3.45% 参数的情况下显著提升长时程任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型缺乏对交互历史的显式访问，容易陷入感知混叠（perceptual aliasing）：不同任务阶段出现相似的当前观测与机器人状态时，会产生动作歧义并降低成功率。已有方法通过特征条件化、动作先验修改或采样引导来引入时序/进度线索，但联合微调记忆模块与基础 VLA 会带来额外的策略训练开销，因此有必要将可训练的历史条件引导与冻结的基础策略精炼相分离。
AI.method: 提出 ActMem-VLA，一种双专家交接（dual-expert handover）架构，在冻结的微调 VLA 上增加记忆插件，插件包含基于 Mamba 的记忆模块与轻量 PreAction Expert（PAE）。Mamba 将已执行动作历史编码为记忆，与当前上下文共同条件化 PAE；PAE 在早期高噪声去噪阶段引导任务推进，随后将部分去噪的动作交给冻结的 Action Expert（AE），在剩余低噪声步骤中精炼动作细节。训练中基础 VLA 全程冻结，仅联合优化 Mamba 模块与 PAE。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Mem 上，ActMem-VLA 在全部十个任务上取得 80.8% 的平均成功率，相比 π0.5 的 65.2% 与 MemoryVLA 的 49.5% 有显著提升，且仅引入 3.45% 的额外参数。在四个真实世界任务上，相比 π0.5 平均成功率提升 28.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可训练的记忆条件引导与冻结的基础策略精炼解耦，ActMem-VLA 在显著降低训练开销（仅训练轻量插件）的同时有效缓解感知混叠，在仿真与真实任务上均取得领先性能，验证了双专家交接架构的有效性与高效性。

title: Recovering the View: Benchmarking Physical Active Vision for Occlusion Recovery in Robotic Manipulation
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, Project page: this https URL
summary: Physical active vision allows robots to change their viewpoint when task-relevant observations become unreliable, yet existing manipulation benchmarks provide limited support for studying how policies recover from occlusion during execution. We introduce BAVO-Bench (Bimanual Active Vision under Occlusion), a bimanual active-vision benchmark that systematically controls external visibility through Clean, Stage Occlusion, and Random-time Occlusion conditions, enabling evaluation of both manipulation performance and active visual recovery. Building on this setting, we present A-FAR (Active Future-Aware Recovery), an active-vision policy for joint viewpoint and manipulation control. A-FAR represents moving-camera observations in a unified robot-centric 3D frame and distills relational structure together with its future evolution from a pretrained 4D model, providing the policy with future-aware geometric guidance without requiring future observations at deployment. Experiments across multiple manipulation tasks show that A-FAR improves robustness to both structured and temporally shifted occlusions while maintaining strong performance under clean observations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出双臂主动视觉遮挡基准 BAVO-Bench 与主动视觉策略 A-FAR，通过统一机器人中心 3D 表征并从预训练 4D 模型蒸馏关系结构及未来演化，实现视角与操作联合控制，在结构化与随机时间遮挡下提升操作鲁棒性，同时保持干净观测下的性能。
AI.motivation: 物理主动视觉使机器人可在任务相关观测不可靠时改变视角，但现有操作基准对执行过程中遮挡恢复的研究支持有限，缺乏系统评估主动视觉恢复能力的平台。
AI.method: 1) BAVO-Bench：双臂主动视觉基准，通过 Clean、Stage Occlusion、Random-time Occlusion 三种条件系统控制外部可见性，同时评估操作性能与主动视觉恢复；2) A-FAR：面向视角与操作联合控制的主动视觉策略，将移动相机观测统一到机器人中心 3D 坐标系，并从预训练 4D 模型蒸馏关系结构及其未来演化，从而在部署时无需未来观测即可获得未来感知的几何引导。
AI.result: 多任务实验表明，A-FAR 对结构化遮挡和时间偏移遮挡均具有更强鲁棒性，并在干净观测下保持较强操作性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为双臂主动视觉遮挡场景提供了可系统评估操作与恢复能力的基准，并提出无需未来观测即可利用未来感知几何引导的有效策略，推动遮挡下主动视觉操作研究。

title: RoboFin3D: A Sim-to-Real Platform for Robotic Surface Finishing
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the IROS 2026 Workshop on Sim2Real and Classical Control: From Rigorous Theory to Data-Driven Robotics
summary: Grinding and sanding are fundamental processes in industrial robotic surface finishing. However, physical trials are expensive and consume workpieces, making reproducible experiments difficult. We present RoboFin3D, a sim-to-real platform built on Isaac Sim and the Newton physics engine, that provides physics-based grinding and sanding simulation for cheap and repeatable robotic surface finishing experiments. RoboFin3D utilizes a signed distance field (SDF) to model the changing geometry of the workpiece, enabling contact computation, live updates and rendering without an intermediate mesh. It additionally uses a separate surface field to model progressive surface appearance change during sanding. We also introduce WeldGen, a weld sampling module, to generate weld beads on 8,918 real-world workpiece meshes for providing diverse simulation assets. The simulation parameters are calibrated on real experimental results and our evaluation demonstrates our simulation's fidelity against the real world. We also demonstrate that simulation-generated data can be used to improve the performance of perception models. Simulation-only fine-tuning of SAM2 improves IoU for segmentation of unsanded regions from 77.15% to 84.47%, while combined synthetic and real training reaches 97.41%.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoboFin3D，一个基于 Isaac Sim 与 Newton 物理引擎的物理仿真到现实平台，用于低成本、可重复的机器人磨削与砂光表面处理实验，并引入 WeldGen 生成焊缝资产，验证了仿真保真度及合成数据对感知模型的提升。
AI.motivation: 工业机器人表面精加工中，磨削与砂光实验成本高、消耗工件且难以复现；需要可重复、低成本的物理仿真平台来支撑实验与数据生成。
AI.method: 构建 RoboFin3D：基于 Isaac Sim 和 Newton 物理引擎；使用符号距离场（SDF）表示工件变化几何，实现无需中间网格的接触计算、实时更新与渲染；另设表面场建模砂光过程中外观渐进变化；提出 WeldGen 焊缝采样模块，在 8,918 个真实工件网格上生成焊缝，提供多样仿真资产；并用真实实验标定仿真参数。
AI.result: 仿真参数经真实实验标定，评估显示仿真对现实具有保真度；仿真生成数据可提升感知模型性能：仅用仿真微调 SAM2，未打磨区域分割 IoU 从 77.15% 提升至 84.47%；合成与真实数据联合训练达到 97.41%。
AI.conclusion: RoboFin3D 为机器人磨削与砂光提供了可重复、低成本的物理仿真方案，并能通过合成数据有效增强表面处理相关感知任务。

title: Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables
summary: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy's state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy's state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering photorealistic observations. The resulting policy achieves 81.2% success in the independent Arena benchmark, compared with 75.0% for the strongest baseline, and succeeds in 19/20 real-robot trials without policy fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将普通单目行走视频直接转换为闭环社交导航训练环境的高效流水线，在策略状态空间中用可通行性地图与行人轨迹回放模拟反事实机器人运动，无需重建或渲染逼真观测。策略在Arena基准成功率达81.2%，优于最强基线75.0%，并在20次真实机器人试验中成功19次且无需微调。
AI.motivation: 训练鲁棒的社交导航策略需要具有多样场景布局、地形和行人运动的模拟器，但构建此类环境并指定行人行为成本高昂。
AI.method: 基于关键观察：局部社交导航主要依赖两类信息——机器人可通行区域和附近行人运动。将静态场景表示为度量可通行性地图，使其可在反事实机器人运动下进行刚性变换；同时直接按时间回放从视频中恢复的行人轨迹。该抽象允许直接在策略状态空间中定义前向动力学，并高效模拟反事实机器人状态，无需重建或渲染照片级真实观测。
AI.result: 在独立Arena基准上达到81.2%成功率，最强基线为75.0%；在20次真实机器人试验中成功19次，且无需策略微调。
AI.conclusion: 将单目行走视频转换为闭环社交导航训练环境是可行且高效的，能够在无需昂贵场景重建和行人行为建模的情况下提升策略鲁棒性与真实机器人迁移能力。

title: RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically operate on RGB images produced by a fixed camera image signal processor (ISP), leaving the imaging pipeline outside the learning and evaluation loop. We systematically examine the consequences of this overlooked design choice across five fundamental ISP dimensions: gain, sensor noise, chromatic response, tonal response, and bit depth. Our analysis reveals that RAW-to-RGB processing materially shapes both action prediction and manipulation success, with different ISP dimensions exerting substantially different effects. Guided by these findings, we introduce RawVLA, a streaming neural ISP that adaptively renders RAW observations for frozen VLA policies while concentrating its capacity on the imaging factors relevant to embodied behavior. We further present RawVLA-Bench, a RAW-domain manipulation benchmark to expose image processing as an explicit evaluation variable across clean and adverse acquisition conditions. Experiments on RawVLA-Bench show that RawVLA preserves performance under standard conditions while substantially improving robustness under degraded imaging, establishing adaptive RAW processing as an effective interface between physical cameras and embodied policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了固定ISP的RAW-to-RGB处理对VLA策略的影响，并提出可流式神经ISP模块RawVLA与RAW域操作基准RawVLA-Bench，以提升退化成像条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通常直接使用固定相机ISP输出的RGB图像，使成像管线被排除在学习与评估闭环之外；作者希望揭示这一被忽视设计选择对动作预测与操作成功率的影响。
AI.method: 围绕增益、传感器噪声、色度响应、色调响应和位深五个ISP维度进行系统分析；提出RawVLA，一种流式神经ISP，为冻结的VLA策略自适应渲染RAW观测，并将容量集中于与具身行为相关的成像因素；同时构建RawVLA-Bench，在干净与恶劣采集条件下将图像处理作为显式评估变量。
AI.result: RAW-to-RGB处理显著影响动作预测和操作成功，不同ISP维度的影响差异明显；在RawVLA-Bench上，RawVLA在标准条件下保持性能，并在成像退化时显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应RAW处理可作为物理相机与具身策略之间的有效接口。

title: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail when a robot's executed motion deviates from their commanded action. Such execution errors arise from the robot's mechanics and operating conditions, such as wear and payload changes. We propose self-compensating VLA, a deployment-time adaptation method that enables a VLA policy to pre-compensate for the robot's execution errors when generating commands. Without task rewards or labels, it updates the policy online using the residual between the action commanded by a VLA and the motion executed by the robot. To stress-test VLA robustness across execution conditions that are impractical to cover with physical robots alone, we introduce RoboStress, a controlled simulation benchmark. It combines established joint-level models of friction, backlash, compliance, and gravity-compensation error into seven deployment scenarios whose execution errors depend on the robot's state and motion history. On RoboStress, self-compensating VLA achieves higher average task success than both the base policies and methods that build in robustness during training. On two physical robot arms with different usage histories, it raises the average task success rate by more than 30 percentage points on each arm, and the gains extend to objects not seen in the task demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自补偿VLA（self-compensating VLA）：一种部署时自适应方法，利用VLA指令动作与机器人实际执行运动之间的残差在线更新策略，无需任务奖励或标签，从而预补偿执行误差。作者还构建RoboStress仿真基准，覆盖七种由状态与运动历史决定的执行误差场景。实验表明，该方法在仿真中优于基础策略和训练时鲁棒性方法；在两台不同使用历史的真实机械臂上平均任务成功率提升超过30个百分点，并泛化到未见物体。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在机器人实际执行运动偏离指令动作时容易失败。此类执行误差来自机械磨损、负载变化等机器人力学与工况因素，且仅靠物理机器人难以覆盖多种执行条件。因此，需要一种无需任务奖励或标签、可在部署时在线适应执行误差的方法，并需要可控的压力测试基准。
AI.method: 提出self-compensating VLA：在部署阶段，用VLA输出的指令动作与机器人实际执行运动之间的残差，在线更新VLA策略，使其在生成命令时预补偿执行误差，不依赖任务奖励或标签。为系统评估，构建RoboStress受控仿真基准，将关节级摩擦、间隙、柔顺和重力补偿误差等模型组合为七种部署场景，且执行误差依赖机器人状态与运动历史。
AI.result: 在RoboStress上，self-compensating VLA的平均任务成功率高于基础策略和训练时鲁棒性方法。在两台具有不同使用历史的真实机械臂上，该方法将每台机械臂的平均任务成功率提升超过30个百分点，并且性能增益可扩展到任务演示中未出现的物体。
AI.conclusion: self-compensating VLA能够在不使用任务奖励或标签的情况下，通过部署时在线残差学习有效预补偿执行误差，提升VLA策略在仿真与真实机器人上的任务成功率，并具备对未见物体的泛化能力。RoboStress为评估VLA在多样执行条件下的鲁棒性提供了可控仿真基准。

title: Anisotropic Representations Improve Planning in JEPA World Models
summary: Latent world models learn action-conditioned dynamics in representation space and often score candidate actions by Euclidean distance to a goal representation. Joint training typically regularizes the representation to prevent collapse, but the resulting representation geometry also determines how terminal errors are weighted during planning. We show that accurate prediction and noncollapsed representations do not guarantee a task-aligned latent planning cost: isotropic Gaussian regularization can induce a geometry that ranks feasible outcomes differently from the task cost. To address this mismatch, we introduce AnisoWM with $\Lambda$Reg, which replaces the fixed isotropic Gaussian target with a learnable diagonal covariance under fixed-trace and anisotropy constraints. The prediction objective, predictor architecture, and Euclidean planner remain unchanged; the target is used only during training. Our analysis characterizes the prediction-driven allocation of target variance, its dependence on the training distribution, and the conditions under which the induced metric reduces planning regret. Across four visual control environments, AnisoWM improves planning success over LeWorldModel in all four. Its latent planning cost also shows better agreement with task outcomes. AI.tldr: 论文指出潜世界模型中"预测准确+表示不塌缩"并不足以保证潜空间规划代价与任务目标一致，各向同性高斯正则可能诱导出与任务代价排序不一致的几何结构；为此提出 AnisoWM，用可学习对角协方差（ΛReg）在固定迹与各向异性约束下替换固定各向同性高斯目标，仅改变训练目标，保持预测目标、预测器结构与欧氏规划器不变，从而提升规划成功率并使潜规划代价与任务结果更一致。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型通常在表示空间学习以动作为条件的动力学，并以到目标表示的欧氏距离来给候选动作打分。联合训练时常用正则化防止表示塌缩，但正则化同时决定了表示几何，进而决定规划中终端误差如何被加权。作者的核心动机是：预测准确且表示未塌缩，并不保证潜空间规划代价与真实任务代价在排序上对齐；各向同性高斯正则可能产生一种几何，使可行结果的排序与任务代价不同。因此需要一种能塑造任务对齐潜度量的训练目标。
AI.method: 提出 AnisoWM 与 ΛReg：将原本固定的各向同性高斯正则目标替换为可学习的对角协方差，并施加固定迹（fixed-trace）与各向异性（anisotropy）约束。预测目标、预测器架构与欧氏规划器均保持不变，新的目标仅在训练阶段使用，不改变推理与规划流程。文中进一步分析预测驱动下的目标方差分配、其对训练分布的依赖，以及诱导度量在何种条件下可降低规划遗憾（planning regret）。
AI.result: 在四个视觉控制环境中，AnisoWM 在全部四个环境上相较 LeWorldModel 提升了规划成功率；其潜空间规划代价与任务结果之间也表现出更好的一致性（agreement）。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间规划的有效性不仅取决于预测精度与表示是否塌缩，还取决于表示几何所诱导的度量是否与任务代价对齐。通过仅修改训练期正则目标、在固定迹与各向异性约束下学习对角协方差，AnisoWM 能在不改变模型与规划器的前提下改善规划成功率和潜规划代价的任务一致性，说明"任务对齐的潜度量"应成为潜世界模型训练中的关键设计维度。

title: CogWAM: Aligning Semantic Cognition with World Action Modeling via Event-Driven Interfaces
summary: Robot policies increasingly incorporate semantic reasoning and future-world prediction, yet combining these capabilities does not guarantee that local predictions and actions remain aligned with task progress. We introduce CogWAM, a cognition-guided world-action model that establishes an explicit semantic interface between task reasoning and world-action learning through a persistent Semantic State, which stores completed task events and the active subtask. CogWAM updates this state only when observations indicate semantic transitions, allowing task-level context to persist across multiple action chunks. To bridge semantic context with physical prediction and control, CogWAM employs progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries that selectively extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation. During training, the Semantic State provides shared task-progress context for both branches, while inference removes the future-prediction branch and directly generates actions from observations and the maintained state. We further introduce semantic training strategies to improve transition learning and closed-loop conditioning. Without additional robot-action pretraining, CogWAM achieves 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR on RoboDojo and state-of-the-art performance on BiCoord, while real-world experiments demonstrate closed-loop dual-arm manipulation with 16.4 fewer Semantic State regenerations than step-wise updating.

AI.tldr: CogWAM 提出认知引导的世界-动作模型，通过持久化 Semantic State 与进度条件查询，将任务语义推理与世界预测、动作生成显式对齐；无需额外机器人动作预训练，在仿真与真实双臂操作中取得高性能并显著减少状态重生成。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人策略虽整合语义推理与未来世界预测，但局部预测和动作未必与任务进度保持一致。论文旨在建立任务级语义推理与底层世界-动作学习之间的显式接口，并让任务上下文跨多个动作块持久保留。
AI.method: 提出 CogWAM，核心为持久 Semantic State，存储已完成任务事件和当前子任务；仅当观测表明语义转移时更新，使任务级上下文跨多个 action chunks 保持。采用 progress-conditioned WORLD 与 ACTION queries，选择性提取任务相关信息，分别用于未来世界预测和动作生成。训练时 Semantic State 为两分支提供共享任务进度上下文；推理时移除未来预测分支，直接由观测和维护状态生成动作。另引入语义训练策略以改进转移学习和闭环条件化。
AI.result: 无需额外机器人动作预训练，CogWAM 在 RoboDojo 上达到 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR，在 BiCoord 上取得 SOTA；真实世界实验实现闭环双臂操作，Semantic State 重生成次数较逐步更新少 16.4 次。
AI.conclusion: 持久语义状态与进度条件查询能有效桥接任务推理与世界-动作学习，提升局部预测与动作对任务进度的一致性，并在仿真和真实机器人操作中兼顾性能与部署效率。

title: Faster and Better? Benchmark Bugs and Design Limitations Distort the Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Acceleration
comment: Includes appendix
summary: Simulated manipulation benchmarks are the standard tool for evaluating vision-language-action (VLA) policies and the acceleration methods that reduce their inference latency for on-robot deployment. On these benchmarks, we observe that some training-free acceleration methods, which approximate the baseline policy's computation, achieve higher measured success rates than the baseline itself. Success rates alone cannot establish whether such gains come from better task execution or from evaluation flaws. We therefore investigate two kinds of benchmark flaws behind these gains: bugs, where the implementation does not match the intended task or evaluation protocol, and design limitations, where success criteria and simulation settings do not fully capture how acceleration affects task execution. Starting from tasks with anomalous gains, we localize root causes by plotting object trajectories against checker acceptance regions, and classify the resulting bugs into task consistency, initialization, and reproducibility. Extending this audit to seven benchmarks, including RoboTwin, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench, we identify 22 bugs of these types and 4 design limitations. For the latter, we revise permissive success checkers, correct unrealistic object masses, and add a motion-aware score that favors smoother actions. Experiments show that bug fixes can reverse method rankings, moving the baseline from last to first on one task. title: RoboHarn-Evo: Evolving Hierarchical Physical Knowledge for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation

summary: Vision-language models can coordinate long-horizon robot manipulation, yet successful task reasoning still depends on whether local physical interactions produce the intended effects. With 80 interaction rollouts, held-out success rises from 48.3% to 75.0% for GPT-5.5 and from 70.0% to 88.3% for GPT-6. title: Urgent Actions Go First: Urgency-Aware Denoising for Real-Time VLA Control
comment: 19 pages
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks through iterative denoising, incurring substantial inference latency that severely limits real-time robotic control. Existing acceleration methods treat an action chunk as a monolithic computational unit, ignoring a crucial physical reality of receding-horizon control: actions are generated jointly but consumed sequentially, resulting in inherently heterogeneous execution urgencies. We exploit this asymmetry to introduce Urgency-Aware Denoising (UAD), a novel inference-time framework that allocates denoising computation according to when each action is physically needed. UAD releases time-critical urgent actions after fewer denoising steps while overlapping the continued background refinement of tail actions with physical execution. However, heterogeneous denoising introduces two key challenges: early-release errors in urgent actions and trajectory inconsistency in tail actions. UAD elegantly resolves both through two core mechanisms: Trajectory Reconciliation, which reconstructs unified internal state evolution to restore joint denoising coherence without additional model evaluations, and Ghost Action Correction, which leverages non-executed ghost continuations to dynamically compensate for early-release errors across remaining executable actions. Extensive evaluations across multiple VLA architectures, simulation benchmarks, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UAD achieves up to a 1.89x speedup in average action availability latency while maintaining comparable success rates to vanilla inference with optimal denoising budget, offering a more favorable success-latency trade-off than state-of-the-art VLA acceleration baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出"紧迫性感知去噪"（UAD）推理框架：利用动作块联合生成但顺序执行的特性，对紧急动作少去噪、对尾部动作后台细化，并借助轨迹调和与幽灵动作校正两项机制消除异构去噪误差，实现最高1.89倍加速且成功率相当。
AI.motivation: Diffusion与flow-matching类VLA策略通过迭代去噪生成动作块，推理延迟高，严重制约实时机器人控制。现有加速方法将动作块视为单一整体计算单元，忽略了退避视界控制的物理事实——动作虽联合生成却被顺序消费，因而各动作的执行紧迫性本质不同。
AI.method: 提出推理时框架UAD，按各动作的物理需求时间分配去噪算力：时间关键的紧急动作更少步数即发布，尾部动作的细化与物理执行并行重叠。针对异构去噪带来的紧急动作提前发布误差与尾部动作轨迹不一致两大挑战，设计两项机制：轨迹调和（Trajectory Reconciliation）在不增加模型评估的情况下重建统一内部状态演化以恢复联合去噪一致性；幽灵动作校正（Ghost Action Correction）利用未执行的幽灵延续动作动态补偿剩余可执行动作的提前发布误差。
AI.result: 在多种VLA架构、仿真基准与真实世界操作任务上评估，UAD在平均动作可用延迟上实现最高1.89倍加速，成功率与最优去噪预算的原始推理相当，相比最先进的VLA加速基线具有更优的成功率—延迟权衡。
AI.conclusion: UAD通过紧迫性感知的异构去噪分配与两项误差校正机制，有效降低VLA策略推理延迟，在不牺牲成功率的前提下实现显著加速，为实时机器人控制提供了更优的折中方案。

title: WayFinder: Hierarchical Visual-Language-Action for Zero-Shot Waypoint Generation and Low-Level Kinematic Control

summary: Visual Language Action (VLA) models offer unprecedented generalization for autonomous robots; however, their real-world deployment is frequently bottlenecked by unreliable execution and the prohibitive computational cost of fine-tuning for specific robot embodiments and tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose WayFinder, an end-to-end, closed-loop hierarchical VLA framework that circumvents the need for fine-tuning by decoupling high-level task reasoning from low-level kinematic control. WayFinder utilizes a zero-shot, offboard Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) policy to process linguistic context and state maps for strategic waypoint generation. Asynchronously, a lightweight, onboard policy executes real-time kinematic control at high frequency based on continuous sensor feedback. We evaluate WayFinder in Microsoft AirSim, testing on four environments of varying complexity and three MLLM scales to balance prediction efficacy with computational efficiency. Our results demonstrate that WayFinder achieves superior navigation reliability compared to baseline low-level policies. By querying the high-level MLLM only during navigation failures, WayFinder eliminates the need for fine-tuning, minimizes expensive inferences, and significantly increases navigation success rates by up to 27.45%.

AI.tldr: 提出 WayFinder——端到端闭环分层 VLA 框架，通过解耦高层任务推理与底层运动控制，无需微调即可实现可靠的机器人自主导航。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型虽具备较强的泛化能力，但实际部署受限于执行不可靠，以及针对特定机器人形态与任务进行微调的高昂计算成本。
AI.method: 采用分层闭环架构：高层由零样本、离线（offboard）的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）策略负责处理语言上下文与状态地图，生成策略性路点；底层由轻量化、机载（onboard）策略基于连续传感器反馈，高频异步执行实时运动控制。仅在导航失败时查询高层 MLLM。
AI.result: 在 Microsoft AirSim 中于四种复杂度不同的环境、三种 MLLM 规模下评测，兼顾预测效果与计算效率；WayFinder 相比基线底层策略具有更优的导航可靠性，导航成功率最高提升 27.45%，同时消除了微调需求并显著减少高开销推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高层推理与底层控制解耦，并结合失败触发式的高层查询，WayFinder 可在免微调、低推理开销的前提下显著提升导航成功率，为 VLA 模型的实际部署提供了可行路径。

title: MVG-WAM: Multiple View Geometry-Aware World-Action Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics with action prediction, bringing the rich priors of pretrained video models to robotic manipulation. However, their multi-view interfaces typically tile images or concatenate tokens, leaving the geometric relationships among synchronized cameras implicit. This makes it harder to connect global scene context with the local geometry required for interaction. We introduce the Multi-View Geometry-Aware World-Action Model (MVG-WAM), which organizes these observations as related projections of one physical world rather than separate images on a canvas. Our model combines an epipolar-constrained global state with view-indexed geometric states jointly inferred from synchronized observations. Camera-aware routing supplies each video region with its corresponding geometric context and the shared global state, explicitly structuring the representation used for action prediction. We further ground the geometry-aware representation in metric scale through multi-horizon future-depth supervision, without requiring depth decoding during action rollout. MVG-WAM achieves average success rates of 99.1% on LIBERO and 92.07% on RoboTwin 2.0, demonstrating competitive performance across both benchmarks. Real-world experiments on Cobot Magic further demonstrate a 91.3% success rate across 150 trials spanning three manipulation tasks.

title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
summary: Vision-language-action and world-action models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in robotics, yet generalization to unseen tasks remains challenging. More recently, general-purpose multimodal agents have shown great potential for zero-shot robotic task solving. However, they often incur high execution costs by reasoning and exploring the physical world from scratch. To reduce these costs, we introduce RoboSkill, a framework that connects skill acquisition and reuse through an Explore, Execute, Evolve loop. Within this loop, the agent explores to gather task-relevant information, executes tasks while adapting to feedback, and evolves its skill library based on execution records. It then reuses these skills to guide exploration and execution in the next cycle, closing the loop. To improve loop efficiency, we complement vision with tactile feedback to reduce uncertainty during physical interaction. We further augment textual guidance with reusable code to reduce reasoning overhead during skill reuse. On LIBERO-10, RoboSkill improves first-episode success rates by 12.5--25.0 percentage points and reduces average runtime by 7.6--72.4% across four agents. On real robots, it improves success rates by 8.3 percentage points and reduces average runtime for successful trials by at least 14.4%.

AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作与世界-动作模型虽在机器人领域表现突出，但面对未见任务时泛化仍困难；通用多模态智能体具备零样本求解潜力，却需要从零推理与探索物理世界，执行成本高。
AI.method: 提出 RoboSkill 框架，构建 Explore、Execute、Evolve 循环：智能体探索任务相关信息，执行任务并根据反馈调整，基于执行记录进化技能库，再复用技能指导下一轮探索与执行。为提升循环效率，引入触觉反馈补充视觉以降低物理交互不确定性，并用可复用代码增强文本指导以减少技能复用时的推理开销。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-10 上，RoboSkill 使四个智能体的首回合成功率提升 12.5–25.0 个百分点，平均运行时间降低 7.6–72.4%；在真实机器人上，成功率提升 8.3 个百分点，成功试验的平均运行时间至少降低 14.4%。
AI.conclusion: RoboSkill 通过技能获取、执行反馈与技能复用的闭环机制，有效降低零样本机器人任务求解中的推理与探索成本，并在仿真与真实机器人上同时提升成功率和运行效率。

title: EgoAlign: Bridging the Human-Humanoid Gap for Long-Range Loco-Manipulation
summary: Egocentric human demonstrations offer an accessible source of task experience, but differences in body scale and controller response, together with missing robot states, limit their value as humanoid training supervision. A final causal replay reconstructs the corresponding robot states and motion-token labels for training with the human observations. We assess the resulting supervision by fine-tuning a vision--language--action model solely on adapted human demonstrations and deploying it zero-shot on a physical humanoid. The resulting policies perform long-range object relocation, navigation to unseen goal positions, and independently evaluated foot interaction. Refinement improves simulated hand alignment and physical pickup success over kinematic alignment alone, while human collection reduces on-site acquisition time relative to teleoperation. this https URL

title: Learning Expressive and Compositional Motion Representation via Spectral Skills
summary: Robotic foundation models offer a promising path toward general-purpose humanoid robot control, often through hierarchical architectures. It also composes new behaviors by adding orthogonal directions to any compatible base skill, producing combinations unseen in the training data. We demonstrate tracking, chaining, and composition, as well as control through a language-conditioned planner, on Unitree G1 hardware. Project page: this https URL

title: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
comment: A work about visual simulators for embodied AI
summary: Real-world robot learning is constrained by the cost of collecting experience and evaluating candidate behaviors. Video generation models offer a scalable foundation for visual simulators that predict action outcomes before physical execution. Yet they often favor visual plausibility over accurate action following and coherent robot--object dynamics, while action-conditioned simulators depend on scarce, embodiment-specific data that are difficult to share across incompatible control spaces. We introduce WorldLine, an action-driven visual simulator that decouples transferable dynamics learning from heterogeneous action grounding. WorldLine learns manipulation dynamics from more than 10,000 hours of action-free robot videos and grounds them using over 2,000 hours of action trajectories across more than ten embodiments. An image-space action representation provides a shared control interface across embodiments, while multi-view and failure-enriched training with relational regularization improves interaction-sensitive prediction. Robot-focused few-step distillation enables efficient causal rollout while preserving action-critical motion. Across held-out and out-of-domain settings, WorldLine maintains strong visual quality and robot-motion agreement; on failed trajectories, it improves robot-mask IoU by 0.1626 over the strongest baseline. It predicts trajectory success with 74% mean accuracy across RoboTwin and AgiBot, one percentage point above the strongest baseline. Without RoboTwin training or adaptation, its rollouts improve task success by up to 21.4 percentage points over direct policy execution. Together, these capabilities make WorldLine a scalable and efficient visual simulator for policy evaluation and embodied planning.
